significance: A cave temple at Bidar reached by wading some 300 metres along a water-filled tunnel cut under the Manichoola hills, where Narasimha is worshipped alongside a Shiva linga. It is counted among the 108 Abhimana Kshetrams of the Vaishnava tradition.
story: The demon Jharasura, slain by Narasimha, is said to have turned into water that has flowed from the god's feet through the tunnel ever since.
